say:1:1130713001:1.text: Ever since rumors about the treasure of the Crimson Highlands started spreading, a good number of members of nearby clans have gone missing.
say:1:1130713001:1.source_cn: 唉，自从深红高原传出宝藏传说后，附近部族不少族民外出后...

say:2:1130713002:1.text: I heard they were taken by the Quicksand Claws.
say:2:1130713002:1.source_cn: 有人说，他们都是被流沙之爪的那帮强盗抓走了。

say:3:1130713003:1.text: If those Quicksand Claws dare touch my little girl, I'll rip them to shreds!
say:3:1130713003:1.source_cn: 但是，如果流沙之爪真的敢伤害我的女儿，我一定会和他们拼命的！

say:4:1130713004:1.text: Little Tara is all I have left. I must protect her!
say:4:1130713004:1.source_cn: 我只剩下小塔拉了，无论如何都要保护好她！
